home.hero.h1: We solve real problems with judgment and software.
home.hero.body: We design, build and adapt software for companies.
home.thesis.heading: Specific problems call for custom software.
home.thesis.p1: Every company accumulates processes, knowledge and ways of operating that make it different.
home.thesis.p2: Off-the-shelf software solves standard problems extraordinarily well. But not every problem is standard.
home.thesis.p3: We design technology around the business: we build when it's worth building, adapt when there's no need to start from scratch, integrate what already works, and apply artificial intelligence when it adds a real capability.
home.thesis.p4: The goal isn't to create more software. It's to make technology fit the company better.

home.firm.heading: The firm
home.firm.body: We work with companies on problems where product, software and business meet. We can build something new, adapt what already exists, connect systems or automate processes. Sometimes the right answer is to build nothing at all.
home.contact.heading: Tell us what you're trying to build.
home.contact.body: Name, email and a line about your problem. No upfront quotes: first we understand what you need.
firm.h1: Software for problems that don't come off the shelf.
firm.intro: We sell judgment, not hours. We understand the business problem first and then decide what's worth doing: buy, adapt, integrate, automate or build.

hero.quote: The greatest fruit of self-sufficiency is freedom.
home.pain.heading.before: Every business wants to use AI.
home.pain.item1.q: "AI is in every pitch. Almost none of it fits our day-to-day."
home.pain.item1.a: Slick demos, integrations that never land, teams that never adopt.
home.pain.item2.q: "We tried a new tool — within a month no one was using it."
home.pain.item2.a: Generic on the surface, fragile underneath, with no context of the business.
home.pain.item3.q: "When we ask who owns AI here, everyone looks at the ceiling."
home.pain.item3.a: The technology moves faster than the organization that has to absorb it.
home.proposal.body1.before: We don't sell software. We sell
home.proposal.body1.after: — the real ability to operate without unnecessary intermediaries, without reactive emergencies, without constant manual reviews.
home.proposal.body2: Applied AI, native integrations, and automation with judgment — all under one system. Your data where it is. Your decisions, yours.
